=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:413-431 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: With `--include-tracked-assets`, `admit_any_suffix=True` admits tracked submodule gitlink (mode 160000) paths, whose worktree path is a directory, and `read_regular(path)` at line 431 raises `ValueError("unsafe file type or size")` because nothing checks first that the asset is a regular file, so the whole snapshot aborts.
  WHY: Every gate run in a consumer repo with a submodule ends permanently as `outcome=unverified reason=snapshot_failed` and prints no `limit_exceeded=1` line, where it passed before this PR; the suggested fix is `if gate_asset and not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode): continue` after `info = path.lstat()` (line 424). All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:399-408,482-500 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: prune_gate_baseline() reuses the admitted command/docs inventory frozen from the PR worktree (`load_admitted_commands(manifest)` line 482, `allowed(name, commands=commands, admit_any_suffix=True)` line 497), so when a PR deletes an admitted `.claude/commands/*.md` or `.claude/docs/*.md` file, the merge-base copy is pruned from the baseline as well.
  WHY: A test that fails because the PR deleted the file fails on both trees, so classify_baseline reports it as inherited and the repair turn for a regression the PR caused is skipped. Severity is disputed: gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR; sonnet rated it NIT with confidence 3, saying only `.claude/docs` is affected (`.claude/commands` comes from the template twin inventory) and the window is narrow.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:431-437 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A newly admitted tracked asset larger than MAX_FILE (8 MiB) makes `read_regular` raise (line 288 / 286-289) before the cap-logging branch at lines 433-437, so no `REVIEW_ISOLATION_SNAPSHOT gate_files=... limit_exceeded=1` line is printed and the grep at scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:253-255 never fires the `reason=snapshot_size` warning.
  WHY: The gate flips from pass to permanent `snapshot_failed` with no count or byte signal, which contradicts the issue's Risks section ("Log the file count and bytes so that shows up"). The gate does not set REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SKIP_OVERSIZED. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:272-274 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The path-free `::error::Review isolation gate baseline prune rejected (<type>) reason=admitted_inventory_missing|baseline_missing|unknown` line (review_untrusted_workspace.py:1002-1008) goes to `${root}/prune.err`, and the cleanup trap (`rm -rf -- "${root}"`, lines 215-220) deletes it on exit without ever surfacing it.
  WHY: Operators see only `outcome=unverified reason=baseline_filter_failed` and cannot tell a missing inventory from a missing baseline or an unexpected error. The suggested fix is to extract the sanitised `reason=[a-z_]+` token and log it. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:139,165 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The keyword-only parameter `admit_any_suffix` is misleadingly named: it only lifts the final ROOT_FILES/SUFFIXES/Dockerfile allowlist check (line 165), while the credential, EXCLUDED, dot-path and command-admission rejects still apply.
  WHY: A future maintainer could take the flag to mean broader admission and weaken a real safety boundary. Both reviewers rated it NIT; sonnet and glm explicitly declined to adopt it as style-only.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:276 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `outcome=info reason=gate_trees` counts line (files/bytes/asset_files/baseline_pruned) is logged only on the full-success path, so a snapshot failure that is not a size failure (e.g. a submodule, a missing host_git_dir) or a baseline_filter_failed loses all counts.
  WHY: Operators triaging a gate that went permanently unverified cannot see how large the trees had grown or what caused the failure, which is the observability the issue's Risks section asks for. Both reviewers rated it NIT; sonnet declined to adopt it as generic logging advice.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:snapshot(), lines 415-418, 419-431 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `--include-tracked-assets` admits tracked gitlink (submodule, mode 160000) entries such as `vendor/lib`, which the suffix allowlist on line 165 used to reject; `is_symlink()` is False and `exists()` is True, so `read_regular` (line 288, `not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)`) raises `ValueError("unsafe file type or size")`.
  WHY: main() exits 1 and prepush_test_gate_run.sh lines 252-257 emit `synthetic_result snapshot_failed` with no `limit_exceeded=1`/`reason=snapshot_size` line, so every gate in a repo with a submodule becomes permanently `unverified`; the baseline side is unaffected; the fix is `if gate_asset and not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode): continue` after line 424.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:snapshot() line 408; prune_gate_baseline() line 482, line 497 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The baseline prune reuses the PR-frozen inventory; a `.claude/docs/<name>.md` (lines 161-162) enters it only if `(host / name).is_file()`, so a PR that deletes `.claude/docs/x.md` also has the merge-base copy pruned (`.claude/commands/*.md` is unaffected because template_command_inventory, lines 261-273, uses the twin directory).
  WHY: The failure is reported as inherited instead of caused by the change, and the repair turn is skipped; the window is narrow (GITHUB_WORKSPACE set, twinned docs file deleted, a test reads it).
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:snapshot() line 431, lines 433-437, line 288; scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh lines 253-255 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: An admitted tracked asset over MAX_FILE (8 MiB) makes read_regular raise before any `limit_exceeded=1` line; only scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:105 sets REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SKIP_OVERSIZED, so no `reason=snapshot_size` warning is logged.
  WHY: The gate becomes permanently `outcome=unverified reason=snapshot_failed` with no count or byte signal, contrary to the issue's Risks section; a ~3-line fix prints the counts line first.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:lines 272-274; trap `cleanup` lines 215-219 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fixed `::error::... reason=admitted_inventory_missing|baseline_missing|unknown` line goes to prune.err, which is never surfaced and is deleted on exit.
  WHY: Operators see only `reason=baseline_filter_failed`; the reason token is already sanitised and safe to log.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Goals 1-4 and the fixture tests were verified; Goal 5 is a post-merge check recorded in the PR description. Not adopted: the `admit_any_suffix` naming nit and the missing `reason=gate_trees` counts on failures other than size failures.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items): skip non-regular gate assets after line 424 (2 lines); print the counts line before read_regular for over-MAX_FILE assets (3 lines); extract `reason=[a-z_]+` from prune.err as `detail=<reason>` (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
